testimonials.name: Beleo
testimonials.role: High Masters to Champ 5 96% in 3 Weeks
testimonials.quote: I started as a gm1 peak soldier otp, with a kovaaks background as a top ground player, dropped to low gm while playing almost fully on my micro, my other hitscans were masters at best. I was mainly coached by trip on my macro and psev helped me with the weaknesses in my aim through kovaaks. The initial routine that psev gave me was pretty good, although it had some annoying scens like air pure and ground plaza dodge, where targets were simply too big to be useful at my skill level. Later he made me a new one that i still use today. We would have 2-3 sessions per week with vod reviews and live coaching, i was also given a game quota per week as to help me get my passion back. Watching my vods trip would only focus on my macro, he would need me to send him a vod where i did really bad or didn't know what i could've done to win and a vod where i did well to make me do it more consistently. On week 1 there was a bit of an improvement since i was just starting to implement new things and playing new heroes, week 2 had me losing a lot and i was given some tips on how to fix streaks of bad days, and on week 3 i slingshot to champ 5, later getting to c5 96%.
